svg.title: Stated confidence of right and wrong answers per model
svg.desc: GPT-6 Astra: median confidence 96% when right (31), 75% when wrong (9); GPT-6.1 Sol: median confidence 97% when right (28), 77% when wrong (12); GPT-6.1 Terra: median confidence 85% when right (20), 42% when wrong (20); DeepSeek V4 Flash: median confidence 90% when right (43), 86% when wrong (45); Qwen 3.8 27B: median confidence 85% when right (5), 85% when wrong (35)
